rows.label: Transaction Tax: standard rate
rows.note: Transaction Tax on goods placed on the Gibraltar market, on the customs value including duties and incidental expenses. Transaction Tax replaces import duty on goods placed on the Gibraltar market (imports and goods made in Gibraltar) from the entry into effect of the UK–EU treaty on Gibraltar (new rules from 15 July 2026, per the Budget address). The Budget address says the standard rate rises to 16% next year and is expected to be 17% from year 3.

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances
rows.source_title: Technical Notice 72/2026: Basic Features of the Customs Union Between Gibraltar and the EU
rows.label: Customs: import duty replaced by Transaction Tax
rows.value: Import duty ceases when the treaty takes effect; Transaction Tax and excise duties apply instead. Non-EU goods clear at designated EU customs offices, which levy the EU Common External Tariff (proceeds paid back to Gibraltar); no customs duties between Gibraltar and the EU.

rows.section: Customs: de minimis, import taxes and traveller allowances

rows.label: Traveller allowance: by sea or air
